tiles.title: What people come to Krush for

items.title: Every day
items.text: Weekdays 10 am to 3:30 pm, weekends 9 am to 5 pm.

items.title: 100% halal
items.text: The whole menu, from Korean chicken to bacon.

items.title: No booking
items.text: Just walk in. At weekends, come early.

items.title: Terrace
items.text: On rue de la Convention. Air-conditioned room in summer.

formule.title: Savoury and sweet, for €25
formule.text: No need to choose: one savoury plate, one sweet plate, a hot drink and a cold drink.

menu.title: The menu
menu.intro: Everything is served every day, à la carte or as part of the set brunch. Prices are the ones on the menu in the restaurant.
menu.priceNote: Prices in euros, service included. Allergies: ask the team, they know every plate.

sale.title: The focaccia is made here
sale.text: Soft, with olive oil, topped with guacamole and beetroot hummus. On the side: feta, fig and red berries. The eggs are organic and local.
sale.alt: Avocado focaccia toast: guacamole, beetroot hummus and edible flowers

sucre.title: Seriously vanilla
sucre.text: French-toast brioche, vanilla cream, fresh raspberries and caramelised almonds. The home-made custard comes on the side, so you pour it yourself.
sucre.alt: Seriously Vanilla brioche with raspberries and caramelised almonds

terrasse.title: A table in the sun
terrasse.text: The terrace looks onto rue de la Convention, two minutes from Javel station. Inside: the pink neon and a cool room in summer.
terrasse.alt: Krush Brunch shopfront and terrace on rue de la Convention

groups.title: Coming as a group?

infos.title: Getting to Krush
infos.accessText: Metro line 10 and RER C, Javel – André Citroën station, a two-minute walk. Charles Michels metro (line 10) is ten minutes away.
infos.noBookingText: We don't take table bookings: first come, first served.
infos.waitText: Late morning is the busiest time. Come at opening, 9 am, to get a table straight away.
infos.map: Map to Krush, 4 rue de la Convention
infos.contactText: Message us on Instagram, the team answers.

items.a: No. Krush works without bookings: come whenever you like during opening hours. At weekends, arriving at opening time saves you a wait.
Yes, the whole menu is halal, meat and charcuterie included: Korean chicken, pulled beef, bacon, turkey lardons, poultry sausage.
Yes, every day: Monday to Friday from 10 am to 3:30 pm, Saturday and Sunday from 9 am to 5 pm. The €25 set brunch too, bank holidays included.
Yes: the avocado focaccia toast, the egg muffin, the Krush Benedict and all the sweet plates are meat-free. Tell the team about any allergies when you order.

items.q: Can we come as a group?
items.a: For a birthday, a hen party or a team, send a request with the Groups form. The team will reply to confirm what's possible.

items.q: Are there high chairs? Can I bring a pushchair?
items.a: Message Krush on Instagram before you come: the team will tell you how best to settle in with little ones.

paris15.metaDescription: Brunch in the 15th arrondissement every day of the week: Krush, 4 rue de la Convention, Javel metro. €25 set brunch, halal, no booking, terrace.
paris15.intro: In the 15th, many brunch spots only serve on Sundays. At Krush it's every day, on rue de la Convention, between Javel and Beaugrenelle.

sections.h: At the end of rue de la Convention
p: Krush is at number 4, two minutes from Javel – André Citroën station (metro 10 and RER C), near the Seine and Parc André-Citroën. Beaugrenelle is a ten-minute walk.
Monday to Friday from 10 am to 3:30 pm, Saturday and Sunday from 9 am to 5 pm. Brunch on a Tuesday lunchtime between meetings? Absolutely.
One savoury plate, one sweet plate, a hot drink and a cold drink. For example: avocado focaccia toast, Seriously Vanilla brioche, a latte and fresh orange juice.
No reservations: just walk in and sit down. At weekends, coming at opening time saves a wait. On sunny days, the terrace looks onto the street.

halal.title: Halal brunch in Paris
halal.metaTitle: Halal brunch in Paris, every day | Krush, Paris 15
halal.metaDescription: Krush, a 100% halal brunch in Paris 15: bacon, Korean chicken, pulled beef, turkey lardons. Open every day, €25 set brunch, no booking.
halal.h1: Halal brunch in Paris, every day
halal.intro: At Krush, the whole menu is halal. Not a separate option: the entire brunch, savoury and sweet.

p: Krush pancakes with bacon, the Krush batata with turkey lardons, the Krush dog with poultry sausage: the dishes you thought were off-limits are on the menu.
The Korean Krush (home-made waffle, Korean chicken, fried egg, hollandaise) and the Moroccan style (pulled beef, candied prunes, cumin, almonds) are the house's most-ordered plates.

sections.h: Every day, in the heart of Paris
p: Open Monday to Sunday at 4 rue de la Convention in the 15th, Javel metro. No booking, with a €25 set brunch.
